column3: KARIYAKSHAMA   SEVA    PADAKKAMA
Orders

column1: REGULATIONS mentioned in the following paragraphs, numbered as Fourthly, Fifthly, Sixthly, Seventhly, Eighthly, Ninthly,
Tenthly,  Eleventhly,  Twelfthly  and  Thirteenthly  published  in  the  Government  Gazette  Extraordinary  Number  412/20
dated 01.08.1986, of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka pertaining to Kariyakshama Seva Padakkama are

column2: Whereas I am desirous of rewarding long, efficient loyal service, and exemplary conduct of proven capacity by

column1: Commissioned Officers, Warrant Officers, Non-Commissioned Officers and Men of the Sri Lanka Army Volunteer Force.

column3: It  is  ordained  that  the  Medal  shall  be  awarded  to  Commissioned  Officers, Warrant  Officers,
Non-Commissioned  Officers  and  Men  of  the  Sri  Lanka Army  Volunteer  Force  who  have
completed  an  aggregate  of  eighteen  years  of  Efficient  Service  on  the Active  list  of  the  Sri
Lanka Army Volunteer Force subject to such conditions as may be laid down in the regulations
hereinafter mentioned and the medal shall be awarded to those who do not receive any other
medal  for  the  efficient  service  on  active  list  of  the  Sri  Lanka Army  Volunteer  Force  for  the
period of service concerned and such service is not counted to award any other medal.
It  is  ordained  that  the  award  of  the  Medal  to  such  Commissioned  Officer, Warrant  Officers,
Non-Commissioned  Officers  and  Men  of  the  Sri  Lanka Army  Volunteer  Force  should  be
recommended by the Commanding Officer of the Unit in which the period of service requisite
to qualify for the Medal is completed ; and such recommendation is certified by the Colonel of
the Regiment and the Commandant of the Sri Lanka Army Volunteer Force and finally approved
by Commander of Sri Lanka Army as efficient and thoroughly capable Commissioned Officers,
Warrant  Officers,  Non-Commissioned  Officers  or  Men  deserving  in  every  way  to  award  the
Medal.
It  is  ordained  that  Commissioned  Officers,  Warrant  Officers,  Non-Commissioned  Officers
and Men on the Reserve of the Sri Lanka Army Volunteer Force are entitled to claim for this
Medal, if at, the time they were placed on the Reserve, they had such qualifying service requisite
for the Medal.
It  is  ordained  that  a  recipient  of  this  medal  shall  not  be  eligible  for  a  second  conferment  or
conferment of clasp during his lifetime.
It is ordained that the Eighth regulation ordained previously to be null.
It is ordained that sealed patterns of the Kariyakshama Seva Padakkama in miniature, which may
be  worn  on  certain  occasions  by  Commissioned  Officers  and Warrant  Officers  on  whom  the
Medal is conferred, shall be half the size of the Kariyakshama Seva Padakkama.
